Episode 155. Back to Lafrarosa (1)
Kwaul and Valeria surprisingly got along well in their conversation.
"Hmm, my lord. That cold lady seems to be handling Mr. Kwaul very well. She's got the man who used to boast big to us acting as obedient as a lamb."
Kwaul was indeed the human version of Murakan, displaying the unique arrogant personality he showed at the hut.

When he first introduced himself to his colleagues, he described himself as the most precious being in the world, and even suggested that anyone who felt uncomfortable with his informal speech could hit him.
Of course, it wasn't out of malice or looking down on others, his way of speaking was just a bit aggressive like Murakan and his skills were outstanding, so his colleagues just accepted it as it was.
Even though he was a bit grumpy, he showed a particularly affectionate side to the children, so there was no need to show him who's boss.

However, as Jet said, he maintained a very polite and respectful attitude towards Valeria, which reminded his colleagues of Murakan. It was like watching Murakan dealing with Jin when he had to secure a limited edition spring painting.
"......Huh, that part was a problem that could be solved as you said! Yeah, I was trying to solve everything too technically."
"It's a common mistake made by engineers. It's not a big deal for a 5-star magician to amplify the effect of that bar device."

"Assuming you've mastered the magic formula you made while talking with me in 10 minutes. I've had countless magic geniuses as my assistants while working in Zifl, but none of them came up with such an idea and immediately made a formula on the spot. You're on a different level!"
"A magician over 8 stars could probably produce more than ten effects with a single bar device. Let's stop here for today. Your head must be full."

"Indeed! As you said, I need to organize the improvement of the device that just came up immediately. And when is our next conversation? Just let me know. I need to adjust my working hours to suit you."
"I'll let you know by evening."
Kwaul immediately took out his writing tools and started writing something down. His colleagues admired Valeria, who turned around haughtily.
Perhaps it was the pride of a student towards their teacher, Jin felt good seeing Valeria's academic side for the first time in a while.
"There's no one as lucky as you, Jin Runcandel. Not only receiving my help, but also capturing such a person."

"You played a big part. One of the conditions that Mr. Kwaul mentioned was to assign a record magician as an assistant. It seems like the one who became the assistant is not you but Mr. Kwaul, as I expected."
"As you expected?"
Valeria looked into Jin's eyes.
She noticed that Jin was speaking as if he knew her very well.
"Um, it's just a comment I made because I can't imagine you being someone's assistant."
Jin quickly covered it up, feeling regretful.
'When the teacher obtains a record magic at the level of previous life...... Will she find out about my regression?'
He felt suffocated whenever such a question came to his mind, wondering how Valeria would react then.
However, on the other hand, he also thought that she was the only one he could fully reveal his secret to.

"If the day comes when Valeria can check all of 'Jin Runkendel's Records', and if she can share those records with her colleagues. Then there will be no need to add any explanation to all the things that have been done so far.
As a regressed person, Jin may have some guilt or sense of responsibility. But he had nothing to be ashamed of.
"You sometimes talk as if you know me well."
At Valeria's straightforward words, Jin nodded calmly.
"Anyone who has seen you even once would think the same as I do. And you also called me by name as if you were someone you originally knew as soon as you saw me."
For a while, the two looked at each other without a word. Valeria recalled Jin she had seen in her dreams long ago, and Jin remembered her from his past life.
'In Jet's view... No matter how you look at it, it's not a common relationship. Have you ever looked at the opposite sex with such eyes?'
'At least not that I know of, Jet.'
'Right? Valkas, you think the same way as me, right? Ha, this. Our Enya must be burning black inside. What about the grace of the non-stop? If this fact reaches Talalis' ears...'
'You two, it would be better to change the subject. Valeria might not know, but if it's this close, he might be listening.'
As Gilli said, Jin roughly understood what Valkas and Jet were saying. Valeria seemed not to hear.
'Even if he heard, he's not the type of person to show interest or give away.'
Valeria was the first to naturally avoid his gaze.

"Anyway, I didn't expect to bring such an engineer in such a short time. Mr. Kwaul's abilities will be very helpful in my personal matters. Arrange a room in Tikhan. I think I will have to be here more often."
"Choose whatever you like from the empty rooms. Ask Gilli or Jet for anything you need."
"Okay."
"And, Valeria."
"Why?"
"Thank you."
"For what?"
"For not harming Veradin and Sandra Jipel. It would have been a golden opportunity for you."
"It's not because I just let them go considering your relationship with them, so you don't need to. I just judged that keeping the two alive would cause more damage to Jipel in the future."
It was a lie.
It was after the two left that Valeria reviewed the record that Veradin would not betray his friends.
This means that even as Valeria, she couldn't be sure of Veradin's psychology until she saw the record.
Moreover, regardless of Veradin's true intentions, depending on how Jipel uses him in the future, it could be a problem for her.
So Valeria just decided to trust Jin once.
"...And it's been quite a while since I've seen that kind of record. It's difficult to read into such personal inner thoughts with my current record magic."
"So how?"

"It means that Veradin's sincerity towards you and Dante Highlan is deep enough to be recognized by my record magic. I hope he doesn't forget that heart, and stands up to the end in destroying Jipel."
Veradin's goal is not the destruction of Jipel, but purification.
Of course, Jipel will be weaker than now, and Valeria planned to annihilate them then.

"I'll tell you in advance, no matter how close you are, to me it's just Jipel. The one who destroyed my roots and family. No matter when I bring him and his family down, if you stand in my way then, our alliance ends there."
Jin didn't answer, and Valeria walked past him after a moment.
Looking at Jin standing dumbfounded, Jet made a fuss about whether the lord had been rejected.
The end of May, 1800.
The ceasefire agreement between Runkandel and Jipel was officially announced. The place was the central square of the imperial capital, right where the emperor was executed.
There has never been a larger crowd in the central square since the founding of the empire.
People from all over the world gathered to watch the ceasefire announcement of the two families.
Stal, the Black Knight Commander, represented Runkandel, and Octavia represented Jipel.

The public guessed that they sent other members of the same rank to represent them since Siron was in the Black Sea, but the two of them were able to announce the agreement because of Runkandel's consideration. Unlike Rosa, Kellick was still unable to move.

"...With this, I will conclude the agreement announcement of the two families. On behalf of the empire, I would like to thank the two families who have made a big decision. Also, our empire will also do our best to reduce the pain of the world together with the two families."
As Dante's speech as the inquirer ended, cheers from the crowd erupted. If you just looked at the atmosphere of the crowd, it felt closer to the end of the war rather than a ceasefire.
With the polluted area continuing to grow, the crowd hoped that whoever provided the cause, the powerful would restore the world as soon as possible.

However, military factions, nobles, and politicians who knew even a little bit about the situation clearly recognized that the current ceasefire is at best a few years of false peace. All they saw was that the identification of PiA became clearer.
Although Dante came out as an inquirer, all the attendees of Highlan stood on the side of Runkandel, and the royal family was all located on the side of Jipel.

After the announcement of the agreement, Highlan handed over the bodies and relics of the two families that they had been keeping, and Runkandel and Jipel each returned to their lands to hold a funeral.
The Garden of Swords had long been adorned with black flags to express mourning. After the funeral, more swords were stuck in the ground in the garden, and more black helmets were added to the grave.
And Jin went to her office to have a private conversation with Rosa.
Today was the first time Jin had returned to the Garden of Swords since the end of the war.
Although it should have been impossible, the family members could no longer openly show hostility towards him.
Even the elders of the Black Sword Association did not reject Jin, who had just returned to the family. There was a strict order from Rosa to behave well when Jin returned.
From the moment Rosa tried to save Jin by disregarding everything in the Sword Emperor's Palace, Jin had effectively consolidated his position as the 'next family head'.
"You're late."
Rosa said in a dry voice. Jin was careful not to look at her chaos that was not covered by clothes.
"I had a lot to do."
"There should have been a harvest."
It was a conversation about mechanical devices and blueprints. Also, Rosa wondered if Jin had found any clues about 'chaos erosion'.
"It seems like you're getting impatient, mother."
"Are you being cheeky to me now?"
"I just said it because I'm worried."
Rosa smiled.
"It looks like you're worried that I might negotiate hastily with the prophet because the situation is more urgent than you expected."
"I won't deny it. After today, I plan to leave for a while."
At those words, Rosa's pupils narrowed.
